design_detail: Progressive annual net wealth tax and removal of share valuation discount
quote_original: SV vil redusere forskjellene i makt og rikdom i samfunnet vårt, og mener de aller rikeste bør bidra mer til fellesskapet. Derfor ønsker vi en mer progressiv formuesskatt, å fjerne rabatten for aksjer i formuesskatten
quote_en: SV wants to reduce differences in power and wealth in our society, and believes the richest should contribute more to the community. Therefore we want a more progressive wealth tax, removing the discount for shares in the wealth tax
grading_note: Party policy page detailing progressive annual net wealth tax design.

design_detail: Defending annual net wealth tax and rate increases against repeal
quote_original: Formuesskatten gjør at de rikeste bidrar til fellesskapet, og er med på å redusere forskjeller. Vi vil dette med formuesskatten: Omfordele mer ved å beholde endringene våre i formuesskatten for et likere og mer rettferdig Norge.
quote_en: The wealth tax ensures that the richest contribute to the community, and helps reduce inequality. We want this with the wealth tax: Redistribute more by keeping our changes in the wealth tax for a more equal and fair Norway.
grading_note: Party platform defending existing wealth tax and rate increases.

design_detail: Progressive wealth tax with high standard deductions, defending against abolition
quote_original: Senterpartiet mener at skatt på inntekt, formue og næringsoverskudd er viktige finansieringskilder for fellesskapet, og at skattebyrden skal fordeles rettferdig. Dette innebærer skatt etter evne, både for inntekt og formue. Senterpartiet støtter en progressiv inntekts- og formuesskatt med høye bunnfradrag.
quote_en: The Centre Party believes that tax on income, wealth and business surplus are important sources of financing for the community, and that the tax burden must be distributed fairly. This entails tax according to ability, both for income and wealth. The Centre Party supports a progressive income and wealth tax with high standard deductions.
grading_note: Official party programme entry defending wealth tax against abolition.

design_detail: Increased wealth tax rate on the largest fortunes with higher basic deduction
quote_original: Øke bunnfradraget i formuesskatten kraftig og øke skattesatsen for de aller største formuene.
quote_en: Substantially increase the basic deduction in the wealth tax and increase the tax rate for the very largest fortunes.
source_title: Skatt og avgifter | Miljøpartiet De Grønne
grading_note: Party tax platform calling for higher wealth tax rate on largest fortunes.

design_detail: Defending annual wealth tax against abolition and supporting progressive wealth taxation
quote_original: Formuesskatten er derfor vårt viktigste verktøy for å redusere økende forskjeller gjennom skattesystemet.
quote_en: The wealth tax is therefore our most important tool to reduce growing inequality through the tax system.
grading_note: Official LO publication defending wealth tax as principal anti-inequality tax tool.

design_detail: Increased wealth tax rates to reduce wealth inequality
quote_original: Formuesskatten må økes gjennom økte skattesatser, og hvor det kan vurderes å øke bunnfradrag, slik at vanlige lønnsmottakere ikke blir berørt av skatten.
quote_en: The wealth tax must be increased through higher tax rates, and where increasing the basic deduction can be considered, so that ordinary wage earners are not affected by the tax.
source_title: Fagforbundet vil utjevne forskjellene og øke formueskatten
grading_note: Union submission calling for increased wealth tax rates.

design_detail: Increased wealth tax on the largest fortunes
quote_original: Vi ønsker en omfordelende skattepolitikk, der vi sikrer at de som har mest, også betaler mer. Vi må se på totalen når vi skal diskutere skattepolitikken for fremtiden, sier SV-lederen.
quote_en: We want a redistributive tax policy, where we ensure that those who have the most also pay more. We have to look at the total picture when discussing tax policy for the future, says the SV leader.
grading_note: SV leader presenting party tax proposals including increased tax on largest fortunes.

design_detail: Defending annual wealth tax against proposed 20bn NOK cut
quote_original: Formuesskatt er den de aller rikeste i Norge, de som eier dagligvarekjeder, har store aksjeposter i bankene, som driver med finans- og eiendomsutvikling, betaler. Da blir det helt feil å kutte i denne skatten og la arbeidsfolk, pensjonister og uføre sitte igjen med regninga, mener hun.
quote_en: Wealth tax is what the very richest in Norway, those who own grocery chains, have large shareholdings in banks, who run finance and property development, pay. Then it is completely wrong to cut this tax and leave workers, pensioners and disabled people with the bill, she believes.
source_title: Milliarder i skattelette til de rikeste: – Sinnssyk prioritering
grading_note: Rødt leader defending the wealth tax against proposed 20bn cut.

design_detail: Defending municipal wealth tax against 15m NOK local loss from abolition
quote_original: Kragerø-ordfører Charlotte Therkelsen sier at kutt i formuesskatten vil ramme inntektene til kommunen.
quote_en: Kragerø mayor Charlotte Therkelsen says that cuts to the wealth tax will hit municipal revenues.
source_title: Milliarder i skattelette til de rikeste: – Sinnssyk prioritering
grading_note: Mayor calculating municipal revenue losses and defending municipal wealth tax.

design_detail: Multi-bracket wealth tax with higher rate over 20m NOK
quote_original: Formuesskatten kan utformes slik at eiere av mindre bedrifter får lettelser uten at eiere av store formuer betaler mindre skatt, skriver professor Jarle Møen.
quote_en: The wealth tax can be designed so that owners of smaller businesses receive relief without owners of large fortunes paying less tax, writes Professor Jarle Møen.
grading_note: NHH economics professor op-ed proposing progressive wealth tax design.

design_detail: Permanent annual wealth taxes starting at 2% for millionaires and up to 5% for billionaires
quote_original: Jeg har signert oppropet fordi et bedre skattesystem er et viktig tema for meg som bedriftsleder. Å øke skatten på formue, og redusere den på arbeid, vil gjøre økonomien mer effektiv og rettferdig.
quote_en: I signed the appeal because a better tax system is an important issue for me as a business leader. Increasing tax on wealth, and reducing it on work, will make the economy more efficient and fair.
source_title: Norsk gründer og 101 andre superrike krever å få betale mer skatt
grading_note: Wealthy entrepreneur signing millionaire open letter In Tax We Trust for permanent wealth taxes.

design_detail: Defending municipal wealth tax against local cuts and tax competition
quote_original: Hvis flere og flere kommuner senker skattene sine, vil de totale skattene som går til Kommune-Norge falle, og dette taper de fattigste kommunene mest på.
quote_en: If more and more municipalities lower their taxes, the total taxes going to Local Government Norway will fall, and the poorest municipalities will lose the most.
grading_note: Civil society op-ed defending municipal wealth tax against local cuts.

design_detail: Defending 35bn NOK annual wealth tax against proposed 20bn cut
quote_original: Jo da, formuesskatt er ikke den eneste skatten vi har for å beskatte landets rikeste, men at den er sentral i å minske økonomisk ulikhet og motvirke maktkonsentrasjon er det ikke tvil om.
quote_en: Sure, the wealth tax is not the only tax we have to tax the country's richest, but there is no doubt that it is central to reducing economic inequality and countering concentration of power.
grading_note: Newspaper editorial defending the wealth tax against proposed 20bn cut.

design_detail: Defending annual wealth tax and calling repeal poison in the Norwegian model
quote_original: der han omtala fjerning av formuesskatten som «gift i den norske modellen» - fordi mange av dei rikaste då ikkje ville betale skatt.
quote_en: where he described the abolition of the wealth tax as "poison in the Norwegian model" - because many of the richest would then not pay tax.
source_title: Utfordrar Vedum om skatt på landbrukseigedom
grading_note: Finance Minister defending the wealth tax against repeal.

design_detail: Defending annual wealth tax against abolition and warning against zero-taxpayers
quote_original: Høyre vil fjerne hele formuesskatten. Ikke mer, eller mindre formuesskatt, men fjerne alt. Høyre er besatt av formuesskatten, sa Jonas Gahr Støre. – Det vil gi 25 000 nye nullskattytere.
quote_en: Høyre wants to eliminate the entire wealth tax. Not more, or less wealth tax, but eliminate everything. Høyre is obsessed with the wealth tax, said Jonas Gahr Støre. – That will create 25,000 new zero-taxpayers.
source_title: Jonas Gahr Støre mener Høyre er besatt av formuesskatten
grading_note: Labour Party leader speech defending the wealth tax against abolition.

design_detail: Opposing wealth tax cuts and calling for stronger taxation of billionaires
quote_original: Dette er skreddersydde skattekutt for landets aller, aller rikeste. Vi får stadig flere milliardærer i Norge. De aller fleste av dem betaler knapt skatt nå.
quote_en: These are tailored tax cuts for the country's very, very richest. We get ever more billionaires in Norway. The vast majority of them barely pay taxes now.
source_title: Solbergs regjering har gitt ni milliarder kroner i skattelette
grading_note: SV chief finance spokesperson criticizing wealth tax cuts and calling for taxing billionaires.

design_detail: Third bracket in the wealth tax for fortunes over 100 million NOK
quote_original: Formuesulikheten i Norge er ekstremt høy. Dagens skattesystem fungerer sånn at det rikeste prosenten betaler en lavere prosentandel i skatt den det en sykepleier eller rørlegger gjør. Sånn kan vi ikke ha det
quote_en: Wealth inequality in Norway is extremely high. Today's tax system functions in such a way that the richest percentile pays a lower percentage in taxes than what a nurse or plumber does. We cannot have it like that
source_title: Rødt vil hente milliarder i økte skatter
grading_note: Rødt finance spokesperson presenting budget proposal with increased wealth tax over 100m NOK.

design_detail: Defending the wealth tax to ensure broad distribution of the tax burden
quote_original: ville Berg beholde dagens skatt fordi den «sikrer bred fordeling av skattebyrden og forhindrer at det blir flere nullskattytere.»
quote_en: Berg wanted to retain the current tax because it "secures a broad distribution of the tax burden and prevents more zero-taxpayers from emerging."
source_title: MDG gikk for kompromiss om skatt
grading_note: MDG MP defending wealth tax to prevent zero-taxpayers and distribute burden.

design_detail: Defending wealth tax as indispensable for ensuring the richest pay taxes
quote_original: Store deler av de rikeste i Norge ville ikke betalt skatt om det ikke var formueskatt, forteller Kalle Moene, professor i samfunnsøkonomi ved Universitet i Oslo.
quote_en: Large parts of the richest in Norway would not pay taxes if it were not for the wealth tax, says Kalle Moene, professor of economics at the University of Oslo.
source_title: Økonomiprofessor: De rikeste må betale mer skatt
grading_note: Economics professor defending wealth tax as necessary to prevent untaxed fortunes.

design_detail: Policy paper showing wealth tax reduces inequality and does not reduce jobs
quote_original: Formuesskatten er et effektivt virkemiddel for å redusere formuesulikhet.
quote_en: The wealth tax is an effective policy instrument for reducing wealth inequality.
source_title: Gjør formuesskatten det vanskeligere å være rik i Norge?
grading_note: Think tank briefing analyzing wealth inequality and defending progressive wealth tax.

design_detail: Defending wealth tax as sound policy against abolition
quote_original: Fjernar vi formuesskatten, vil nokon av samfunnets rikaste betale ingen eller berre litt skatt. Det er vanskeleg å forsvare i møte med alle andre truskyldige skattebetalarar her i landet.
quote_en: If we abolish the wealth tax, some of society's richest will pay none or only a little tax. That is difficult to defend in the eyes of all other trusting taxpayers in this country.
grading_note: Think tank op-ed defending the wealth tax against conservative abolition arguments.

design_detail: Trade union statement criticizing wealth tax cuts and defending progressive taxation
quote_original: Regjeringens kutt i formuesskatt hjelper ikke vanlige folk for å si det slik
quote_en: The government's cuts in the wealth tax do not help regular people to put it that way
source_title: Lønnsoppgjøret starter igjen: – Vi vil kjempe for dem som sitter nederst ved bordet
grading_note: Union leadership defending progressive taxation and opposing wealth tax cuts.

design_detail: Trade union leader statement criticizing wealth tax cuts and defending redistribution
quote_original: Regjeringens kutt i formuesskatt hjelper ikke vanlige folk for å si det slik
quote_en: The government's cuts in the wealth tax do not help regular people to put it that way
source_title: Lønnsoppgjøret starter igjen: – Vi vil kjempe for dem som sitter nederst ved bordet
grading_note: Fellesforbundet leader defending progressive taxation and opposing wealth tax cuts.

design_detail: Party alternative budget with third bracket in wealth tax over 100m NOK
quote_original: Partiet vil øke formuesskatten ved å innføre et tredje trinn for formuer over 100 millioner kroner. Det alene vil gi økt skatteinngang på 15 milliarder kroner.
quote_en: The party wants to increase the wealth tax by introducing a third bracket for wealth exceeding 100 million kroner. That alone will yield increased tax revenue of 15 billion kroner.
source_title: Rødt vil hente milliarder i økte skatter
grading_note: Party budget platform calling for higher wealth tax bracket on fortunes over 100m NOK.

design_detail: Defending wealth tax against abolition while supporting targeted adjustments
quote_original: Vi er opptatt av en rettferdig fordeling, og da er en økning av bunnfradraget i formuesskatten mer treffsikkert enn å fjerne skatten på aksjeformuer, sier Moflag.
quote_en: We are concerned with fair distribution, and then an increase in the basic deduction in the wealth tax is more targeted than removing the tax on share fortunes, says Moflag.
source_title: En halv million nordmenn kan slippe formuesskatt
grading_note: Finance committee chair statement defending wealth tax against elimination.

design_detail: Defending existing wealth tax against repeal as mandate of general election
quote_original: Formuesskatten vil bestå de neste fire årene, slik den har gjort de siste tjue årene, sier stortingsrepresentant Geir Pollestad
quote_en: The wealth tax will remain for the next four years, as it has done for the past twenty years, says Member of the Storting Geir Pollestad
source_title: Sp åpner for vern med justeringer: – Formuesskatten vil bestå
grading_note: Sp budget negotiator and minister rejecting repeal of wealth tax.

design_detail: Economist defense of wealth tax debunking corporate lobby report on effective tax burden
quote_original: I Menons eksempler brukes emisjonsverdien som om selskapene var børsnoterte. Dermed blåses formuesskattens betydning opp i en slik grad at den farger resultatene.
quote_en: In Menon's examples the issue value is used as if the companies were listed. Thus the significance of the wealth tax is inflated to such an extent that it colours the results.
source_title: Graverende feil i NHO sin skatterapport
grading_note: Economics professor op-ed debunking anti-wealth-tax business lobby models.

design_detail: Finance professor defense of wealth tax debunking corporate lobby calculations
quote_original: I Menons eksempler brukes emisjonsverdien som om selskapene var børsnoterte. Dermed blåses formuesskattens betydning opp i en slik grad at den farger resultatene.
quote_en: In Menon's examples the issue value is used as if the companies were listed. Thus the significance of the wealth tax is inflated to such an extent that it colours the results.
source_title: Graverende feil i NHO sin skatterapport
grading_note: Finance professor op-ed defending tax system analysis against business lobby bias.

design_detail: Campaign for redistributive capital taxation including annual wealth tax
quote_original: Om det blir snudd om på Norsk skattepolitikk, må det bli den fremtidige regjeringens mål å skattlegge kapital mer. Dette gjennom skatter som formuesskatt, arveskatt og selskapsskatt.
quote_en: If Norwegian tax policy is reversed, it must be the future government's goal to tax capital more. This through taxes such as wealth tax, inheritance tax and corporate tax.
source_title: Norge går i feil retning i fordelingspolitikken!
grading_note: Civil society organisation policy piece advocating wealth and capital taxation.

design_detail: Trade union leadership opposing proposals to cut wealth tax
quote_original: Dette er helt bakvendt. Vi er ikke tjent med et mindre omfordelende skattesystem, tvert imot må skattesystemet bli mer progressivt, sier hun.
quote_en: This is completely backwards. We are not served by a less redistributive tax system; on the contrary, the tax system must become more progressive, she says.
source_title: NTL reagerer på skatteforslag: – Helt bakvendt
grading_note: Civil service union statement defending wealth tax against reduction.

design_detail: Union president defending progressive wealth taxation against reduction proposals
quote_original: Dette er helt bakvendt. Vi er ikke tjent med et mindre omfordelende skattesystem, tvert imot må skattesystemet bli mer progressivt, sier hun.
quote_en: This is completely backwards. We are not served by a less redistributive tax system; on the contrary, the tax system must become more progressive, she says.
source_title: NTL reagerer på skatteforslag: – Helt bakvendt
grading_note: Union president statement rejecting wealth tax cuts.

Svaret bør imidlertid ikke være å fjerne formuesskatten, men å reformere den
quote_en: The wealth tax contributes to redistribution in the Norwegian tax system, and also allows keeping other taxes lower to support a broad-base low-rate system... The answer however should not be to abolish the wealth tax, but to reform it.
source_title: Svaret er ikke å fjerne formuesskatten, men å reformere den
grading_note: Signed op-ed by economist and think tank deputy director arguing for wealth tax retention and reform.

grading_note: In-depth economic research overview by think tank economist on expert consensus behind the wealth tax.

quote_en: The wealth tax is important for an efficient tax system — and for the social contract of the welfare state to endure... If we remove the wealth tax, some of society's wealthiest will pay no or barely any tax.
grading_note: Signed debate article defending the wealth tax against calls for its abolition.

design_detail: Commentary defending the Norwegian wealth tax as strongly redistributive and preventing zero-tax millionaires

quote_en: But the Norwegian wealth tax also has a positive side, for it is strongly redistributive. If we remove the wealth tax, we will get more zero-taxpayers in Norway.

quote_en: It is completely permissible for the wealthy to not want to pay wealth tax. But do not pretend that it is for the good of working people!... For when less tax enters state coffers, there is less to distribute, Edvardsen points out.
source_title: – Det er trygghet som er frihet, ikke skattelette
grading_note: Signed interview with trade union president defending wealth taxation.

design_detail: Official trade union position defending the wealth tax as funding public welfare services and kindergartens
quote_original: Det er helt lov for de rike å ikke ville betale formuesskatt. Men ikke lat som om det er fordi det er til det beste for arbeidsfolk ... For når det kommer mindre skatt i statskassa, blir det mindre å fordele ut påpeker Edvardsen
quote_en: It is completely permissible for the wealthy to not want to pay wealth tax. But do not pretend that it is for the good of working people!... For when less tax enters state coffers, there is less to distribute, Edvardsen points out.
source_title: – Det er trygghet som er frihet, ikke skattelette
grading_note: Official statement of Norsk Arbeidsmandsforbund on wealth tax retention.

design_detail: Billionaire industrialist and philanthropist defending wealth tax payment as a matter of civic pride and solidarity
quote_original: Trond Mohn kaller skatteflyktningene usolidariske og viser til viktigheten i å betale skatt for å finansiere Norge ... Den følelsen av å betale skatten og bidra til samfunnet, den følelsen gir stolthet, sier Mohn
quote_en: Trond Mohn calls tax refugees unsolidary and points to the importance of paying tax to finance Norway ... That feeling of paying tax and contributing to society, that feeling gives pride, says Mohn.
grading_note: Direct feature interview with billionaire industrialist Trond Mohn on wealth and civic tax duty.

design_detail: Architecture and defense of the 2006 wealth and dividend tax reform ensuring the wealthy contribute
quote_original: SV presiserer i rapporten at de rike bidrar til fellesskapet som aldri før, mens de som ikke har så mye, betaler mindre. Innføring av utbytteskatt og omlegging av formuesskatten er nøkkelord
quote_en: SV states in the report that the rich contribute to the community like never before, while those who have less pay less. Introduction of dividend tax and restructuring of the wealth tax are key words.
grading_note: Policy report and ministerial leadership review presented by former Finance Minister Kristin Halvorsen.

design_detail: Parliamentary leadership and party report highlighting the restructuring and defense of progressive wealth tax
quote_original: SV presiserer i rapporten at de rike bidrar til fellesskapet som aldri før, mens de som ikke har så mye, betaler mindre. Innføring av utbytteskatt og omlegging av formuesskatten er nøkkelord
quote_en: SV states in the report that the rich contribute to the community like never before, while those who have less pay less. Introduction of dividend tax and restructuring of the wealth tax are key words.
grading_note: Joint presentation of SV parliamentary and government achievements by Bård Vegar Solhjell.

design_detail: Analysis of corporate financial balance sheets showing that wealth tax falls on solid owners and does not harm enterprises
quote_original: Formueskatten rammer så å si ikke sårbare bedrifter, den treffer kapitaleiere med solid økonomi ... viser de tørre tallene at skatten verken skaper
quote_en: The wealth tax practically does not hit vulnerable businesses, it hits capital owners with solid finances ... the dry figures show that the tax neither creates liquidity crisis nor reduces jobs.
grading_note: Comprehensive analytical essay by Manifest Director Magnus Marsdal dismantling anti-wealth tax claims.

design_detail: Analysis of Scheel Tax Commission premises emphasizing that wealth taxation must be maintained alongside capital gains and dividend taxes
quote_original: Utvalgets anbefaling om å senke selskapsskatten har en rekke forutsetninger, blant annet at utbytteskatten økes og at formuesskatten opprettholdes på dagens nivå
quote_en: The commission's recommendation to lower the corporate tax rate has a number of prerequisites, among them that the dividend tax is raised and that the wealth tax is maintained at today's level.
grading_note: Manifest report co-authored by Chief Economist Lars Gunnesdal on the Scheel tax commission.

design_detail: Formal parliamentary consultation response from Pensjonistforbundet supporting wealth taxation of high-wealth individuals
quote_original: Vi støtter prinsippet om at personer med betydelig formue, også pensjonister, bør bidra gjennom formuesskatten.
quote_en: We support the principle that persons with significant wealth, including pensioners, should contribute through the wealth tax.
grading_note: Formal submission to Stortingets Finance Committee signed by President Jan Davidsen.

design_detail: Formal parliamentary submission on behalf of Pensjonistforbundet confirming institutional support for wealth taxation
quote_original: Vi støtter prinsippet om at personer med betydelig formue, også pensjonister, bør bidra gjennom formuesskatten.
quote_en: We support the principle that persons with significant wealth, including pensioners, should contribute through the wealth tax.
grading_note: Co-signed formal parliamentary submission by Chief Economist Sindre Farstad.

design_detail: Formal institutional consultation response by national pensioners organization advocating targeted progressive wealth taxation
quote_original: Vi støtter prinsippet om at personer med betydelig formue, også pensjonister, bør bidra gjennom formuesskatten.
quote_en: We support the principle that persons with significant wealth, including pensioners, should contribute through the wealth tax.
grading_note: Formal submission to Stortinget representing 250,000 members.

design_detail: Advocating increased capital and wealth taxation alongside inheritance taxation to fund income tax cuts on low earners
quote_original: den fremtidige regjeringens mål å skattlegge kapital mer. dette gjennom skatter som formuesskatt, arveskatt og selskapsskatt. på samme tid kan dette handlingsrommet brukes til å lette på inntektskatten på de laveste skattetrinnene
quote_en: the future government's goal to tax capital more. This through taxes such as wealth tax, inheritance tax and corporate tax. At the same time this fiscal space can be used to relieve income tax on the lowest tax brackets.
source_title: Norge går i feil retning i fordelingspolitikken!
grading_note: Attac Norge policy blog post authored by Øystein Fossbraaten on distribution.

design_detail: Fact-checking media and business lobbying claims against wealth tax using corporate tax assessment registries
quote_original: nå har gode historier om formueskatt for tredje gang knelt under vekten av faktiske forhold. Da er det noen helt andre sin tur til å skamme seg over at de ikke sjekker fakta før de kaster seg på.
quote_en: now good stories about wealth tax have for the third time collapsed under the weight of actual facts. Then it is someone else's turn to feel ashamed that they do not check facts before jumping on.
grading_note: Analytical critique by Julie Lødrup on media misinformation regarding wealth taxation.

design_detail: Rejecting claims that wealth tax cuts stimulate jobs and emphasizing that wealth taxation ensures high-net-worth individuals contribute to welfare
quote_original: Å redusere formuesskatten gjør at de rikeste i samfunnet bidrar mindre. Det finnes ikke empirisk belegg for å hevde at det vil ha positive konsekvenser for noe annet enn tykkere lommebok for de med mest i samfunnet.
quote_en: Reducing the wealth tax makes the richest in society contribute less. There is no empirical evidence to claim that it will have positive consequences for anything other than thicker wallets for those with the most in society.
source_title: Små forskjeller er et politisk valg
grading_note: Commentary by Tankesmien Agenda CEO Marte Gerhardsen on inequality and wealth tax.

design_detail: Empirical survey of 70,000 corporate financial accounts showing wealth tax is borne by solid capital owners with capacity to pay
quote_original: En gjennomgang av økonomien i over 70.000 norske selskaper viser at det er de mest solide selskapene som får formuesskatt, og at de ikke har problemer med å betale den.
quote_en: A review of the finances in over 70,000 Norwegian companies shows that it is the most solid companies whose owners receive wealth tax, and that they have no problems paying it.
grading_note: Detailed economic report summary by Ida Søraunet Wangberg analyzing wealth tax incidence across 70,000 firms.

design_detail: Endorsing wealth and inheritance taxation as concrete tools to counter return-on-capital concentration
quote_original: Formuesskatt, toppskatt og arveavgift er blant tiltakene han nevner som bidrar til å motvirke disse effektene. Flere grep ligger altså rett foran oss.
quote_en: Wealth tax, top bracket income tax and inheritance tax are among the measures he mentions that help counter these effects. Several actions thus lie right before us.
grading_note: Economic essay by Ingrid Grønli Åm on capital returns and progressive taxation.

design_detail: Criticizing regressive consumption taxes and tax cuts on wealth and inheritance that favor the wealthy
quote_original: slipper rikfolket unna gjennom at arveskatt og formuesskatt kuttes. Johan Nygaardsvold, som var statsminister før og under andre verdenskrig, mente matmomsen var en fattigmannsskatt
quote_en: the rich get away through cuts in inheritance and wealth tax. Johan Nygaardsvold, who was prime minister before and during World War II, considered food VAT a poor man's tax.
grading_note: Historical and fiscal policy analysis by Andreas Tharaldsen on capital tax defense.

design_detail: Endorsing progressive net wealth taxation with high basic exemptions across all capital assets
quote_original: Piketty er særlig opptatt av kapitalbeskatning, altså formuesskatt, og arveavgift ... Piketty foreslår derfor i stedet en samlet skatt på all kapital, med et høyt bunnfradrag og progressive satser
quote_en: Piketty is particularly focused on capital taxation, namely wealth tax, and inheritance tax ... Piketty therefore proposes instead a comprehensive tax on all capital, with a high basic deduction and progressive rates.
grading_note: Economic explainer by Thomas Tallaksen on progressive net wealth tax frameworks.

design_detail: Formal consultation statement to the Torvik Tax Commission supporting the retention and progressive broadening of the wealth tax
quote_original: støtter TJN både innføring av arveskatt og at vi beholder formuesskatten ... Vi støtter videre utvalgets forslag om å inkludere flere typer formuesobjekter i formuesskattegrunnlaget.
quote_en: TJN supports both the introduction of an inheritance tax and that we retain the wealth tax ... We furthermore support the commission's proposal to include more types of asset classes in the wealth tax base.
grading_note: Official consultation response to NOU 2022: 20 signed by Executive Director Sigrid Klæboe Jacobsen.

design_detail: Formal consultation submission to NOU 2022: 20 defending retention and progressive design of the wealth tax
quote_original: støtter TJN både innføring av arveskatt og at vi beholder formuesskatten ... Vi støtter videre utvalgets forslag om å inkludere flere typer formuesobjekter i formuesskattegrunnlaget.
quote_en: TJN supports both the introduction of an inheritance tax and that we retain the wealth tax ... We furthermore support the commission's proposal to include more types of asset classes in the wealth tax base.
grading_note: Official consultation response to NOU 2022: 20 signed by Political Director Peter Ringstad.

design_detail: Commentary on democratic integrity and welfare funding defending the wealth tax against multi-million-kroner lobby campaigns
quote_original: Det er en eneste grunn til at formuesskatten blir så heftig diskutert rundt om nå i slutten av valgkampen: fordi det sitter noen få, superrike mennesker og har enormt mye å tjene på høyresidens planlagte skattekutt.
quote_en: There is only one reason why the wealth tax is being discussed so fiercely around now at the end of the election campaign: because there are a few, super-rich people sitting who have enormous amounts to gain from the right-wing's planned tax cuts.
source_title: Formuesskatt er frihet for folk flest
grading_note: Analytical commentary by Helle Cecilie Palmer in Agenda Magasin on election campaigns and tax policy.

design_detail: Ten-point economic defense of the wealth tax emphasizing public finance stability, trust, and business profitability
quote_original: Denne formuesskatten er faktisk helt ok. Tar vi den bort må vi øke andre skatter for vanlige folk. Men det er kanskje ikke de som kjemper mot formuesskatt så bekymret for.
quote_en: This wealth tax is actually completely fine. If we remove it we must increase other taxes for ordinary people. But that is perhaps not what those fighting against the wealth tax are so concerned about.
source_title: Ti grunner til at det er pussig med en kampanje mot formuesskatt akkurat nå
grading_note: Comprehensive essay by Tankesmien Agenda leader Trygve Svensson detailing ten structural reasons to maintain wealth tax.

design_detail: Deconstructing corporate lobbying rhetoric on 'working capital' and showing wealth tax does not damage enterprises
quote_original: en ny studie ... viser imidlertid at formuesskatten ikke ødelegger for disse bedriftene. Regjeringens politikk gir mange milliarder mindre i inntekt til statskassa, til velferden for deg om meg, og den bidrar til å øke de økonomiske ulikhetene.
quote_en: a new study ... shows however that the wealth tax does not destroy these businesses. The government's policy yields many billions less in revenue to the treasury, to welfare for you and me, and it contributes to increasing economic inequalities.
source_title: Det er ingenting som heter arbeidende kapital
grading_note: In-depth economic commentary by Tiril Halvorsen analysing wealth tax incidence.

design_detail: Advocating enhanced progressive net wealth taxation with higher thresholds and broader valuation
quote_original: Vi trenger en ny og mer rettferdig formuesskatt i Norge. Arbeiderpartiets forslag går flere steg i riktig retning, men vi har enda en vei å gå.
quote_en: We need a new and fairer wealth tax in Norway. Labour's proposal takes several steps in the right direction, but we still have a way to go.
grading_note: Debate piece by Ola H. B. Pedersen proposing progressive reform of the wealth tax.

design_detail: Trade union leadership essay defending wealth taxation against right-wing tax cut and deregulation agenda
quote_original: De rødgrønne vil ikke ha skattelettepolitikk, ei heller fjerne formueskatten. Det vil Høyre og Frp. Høyre og Frp vil selge ut statlige virksomheter og redusere statlig eierskap. Det vil ikke de rødgrønne.
quote_en: The red-greens do not want a tax-cut policy, nor do they want to remove the wealth tax. The Conservatives and Progress Party want that. They want to sell off state enterprises and reduce state ownership. The red-greens do not want that.
grading_note: Major policy essay by LO i Oslo leader Roy Pedersen defending collective welfare financing and wealth tax.

design_detail: Rebutting claims by billionaire welfare service providers and explaining that wealth tax ensures the wealthiest contribute to the public commons
quote_original: Formueskatten bidrar til at også de aller mest søkkrike i vårt samfunn bidrar noe til det fellesskapet som har gjort Norge til verdens beste samfunn å leve i
quote_en: The wealth tax ensures that even the very wealthiest in our society contribute something to the community that has made Norway the world's best society to live in.
source_title: Jo rikere de er, jo mer klager de
grading_note: Analytical commentary by Anders Skrede examining commercial welfare operators and wealth tax obligations.

design_detail: Economic analysis of the Scheel Commission showing that wealth tax does not negatively impact investment incentives
quote_original: Scheel-utvalget la fram sin rapport i desember 2014, hvor de sier at selskapsskattens betydning for investeringer ikke må overdrives, og at heller ikke formueskatten har særlig innvirkning her
quote_en: The Scheel Commission presented its report in December 2014, where they state that the significance of corporate tax for investments should not be exaggerated, and that neither does the wealth tax have any particular impact here.
grading_note: Economic commentary co-authored by Fredrik V. Sand in Manifest Tidsskrift evaluating productivity and tax policy.

design_detail: Defending wealth tax against abolition by documenting it prevents 27,000 new zero-taxpayers
quote_original: Det anslås at om lag 510.200 personer ikke betaler formuesskatt eller inntektsskatt i 2025. Dersom formuesskatten fjernes, anslås antallet økt med om lag 27.200 personer, til 537.400 personer, skriver finansminister Jens Stoltenberg (Ap) i sitt svar.
quote_en: It is estimated that around 510,200 people pay neither wealth tax nor income tax in 2025. If the wealth tax is removed, the number is estimated to increase by around 27,200 people, to 537,400 people, writes Finance Minister Jens Stoltenberg (Ap) in his reply.
source_title: 27.000 nye nullskattytere om formuesskatten fjernes, ifølge Stoltenberg
grading_note: Official response to Stortinget highlighting that removing the wealth tax would generate 27,000 additional zero-taxpayers

design_detail: Opposing hundreds of thousands in wealth tax cuts for the richest
quote_original: Som for eksempel hundretusener i formuesskattelette til de rikeste, kutt i ledighetstrygd, kutt i sykelønn, kutt i uføretrygd, kutt i overgangsstønad og kutt i foreldrepenger og pleiepenger. Dette er en profil der de som har det tøft får det tøffere, og de som har mye får mer. Unio mener dette er en veldig uheldig utvikling.
quote_en: Such as hundreds of thousands in wealth tax cuts for the richest, cuts in unemployment benefits, cuts in sick pay, cuts in disability benefits, cuts in transitional benefits and cuts in parental benefit and care benefits. This is a profile where those who struggle get it harder, and those who have a lot get more. Unio believes this is a very unfortunate development.
grading_note: Chief economist of Unio criticizing wealth tax cuts for the rich as regressive policy

design_detail: Warning against lowering wealth tax and affirming the richest must contribute more
quote_original: Det er rettferdig at de rikeste bidrar mer. Og at de med lavere inntekter betaler mindre, sier Helene Harsvik Skeibrok, til FriFagbevegelse.
quote_en: It is fair that the richest contribute more. And that those with lower incomes pay less, says Helene Harsvik Skeibrok to FriFagbevegelse.
source_title: LO-topp advarer mot å senke formuesskatten: – Rettferdig at de rikeste bidrar mer
grading_note: Fagforbundet leader warns against lowering wealth tax and argues that the richest must contribute more

design_detail: Dissenting against commission proposals that would cut wealth tax for the richest
quote_original: Kommisjonens rapport vil bli brukt til å legitimere massive skattekutt til de aller rikeste. Det vil jeg ikke være med på, sier hun til Aftenposten.
quote_en: The commission's report will be used to legitimize massive tax cuts for the very richest. I will not be a part of that, she tells Aftenposten.
source_title: LO-topp advarer mot å senke formuesskatten: – Rettferdig at de rikeste bidrar mer
grading_note: Dissenting member of Torvik tax commission objecting to proposal to cut wealth tax

design_detail: Arguing wealth taxation is indispensable to halt rising economic inequality
quote_original: Den viktigste årsaken til at ulikhetene øker er at de rikeste blir rikere. Skal vi gjøre noe med den økende ulikheten er vi nødt til å skattlegge formuer. Sånn er det bare, og selv om det er forståelig at de som betaler den klager høylytt, så er det enormt viktig at vi ikke lar næringslivselitene diktere skattepolitikken.
quote_en: The main reason why inequality is growing is that the richest get richer. If we are to do something about rising inequality we must tax wealth. That is just how it is, and even though it is understandable that those who pay it complain loudly, it is hugely important that we do not let business elites dictate tax policy.
grading_note: LO economist arguing that taxing wealth is necessary to prevent rising inequality

design_detail: Empirical research demonstrating that progressive wealth taxation reduces inequality and improves redistribution
quote_original: Dersom vi i 2025 hadde beholdt skattesystemet slik det var i 2021, så hadde omfordelingen blitt redusert og ulikheten i 2025 hadde økt, sier Thoresen.
quote_en: If in 2025 we had maintained the tax system as it was in 2021, redistribution would have been reduced and inequality in 2025 would have increased, says Thoresen.
grading_note: SSB senior researcher and UiO professor showing the redistributive effect of progressive tax reforms including wealth taxation

design_detail: Documenting how tax exemptions favour top 10% wealth holders and justifying capital taxation
quote_original: De 10 prosent med størst formue mottar rundt 70 prosent av totale skjermingsfradrag.
quote_en: The 10 percent with the largest wealth receive around 70 percent of total shareholder deduction allowances.
source_title: Skjermingsfradraget – en skattegave til de få?
grading_note: Skatteforsk researcher documenting inequality and the concentration of tax benefits among top wealth holders

design_detail: Critiquing municipal wealth tax cuts as harmful tax competition that drains public services
quote_original: Bøs skattekutt senker mulighetsrommet, ikke for Bø, men for alle kommuner som derfor taper inntekter. For å kompensere må de enten øke skattetrykket for egne innbyggere, eller kutte i offentlige tilbud.
quote_en: Bø's tax cut lowers fiscal leeway, not for Bø, but for all municipalities that therefore lose revenues. To compensate, they must either increase the tax burden on their own residents, or cut public services.
grading_note: Tax Justice Norge adviser criticizing municipal wealth tax cuts as harmful tax competition

design_detail: Advocating fair taxation and transparency against tax flight
quote_original: I denne kampen er rettferdig skattlegging og større finansiell åpenhet blant de viktigste verktøyene.
quote_en: In this fight, fair taxation and greater financial transparency are among the most important tools.
source_title: Ny daglig leder i Tax Justice Norge
grading_note: Executive director of Tax Justice Norge advocating for fair wealth taxation and combating tax avoidance

design_detail: Leading campaign against tax flight and defending progressive wealth taxation
quote_original: Vi i Tax Justice Norge er veldig glade for å ha fått Andreas med på laget som ny daglig leder. Med ham i spissen skal vi løfte debatten om skatteflukt i Norge, sier styreleder Helge Renå.
quote_en: We in Tax Justice Norge are very glad to have Andreas on board as new director. With him at the helm we will elevate the debate on tax flight in Norway, says board chair Helge Renå.
source_title: Ny daglig leder i Tax Justice Norge
grading_note: Chair of Tax Justice Norge highlighting leadership against tax flight and evasion

design_detail: Stating that tax flight is a root cause of poverty and extreme inequality
quote_original: Skatteflukt er en grunnleggende årsak til fattigdom og ekstrem ulikhet i verden, som er noen av hovedgrunnene til at vi engasjerer oss i dette.
quote_en: Tax flight is a fundamental cause of poverty and extreme inequality in the world, which are among the main reasons why we engage in this.
source_title: Ny daglig leder i Tax Justice Norge
grading_note: Board member of Tax Justice Norge arguing tax avoidance causes extreme inequality

design_detail: Arguing that lower tax rates for the super-rich erode social trust and national tax morale
quote_original: At de aller rikeste har betydelig lavere skattesatser enn vanlige lønnsmottakere, sliter på tilliten og skattemoralen nasjonalt.
quote_en: That the very richest have significantly lower effective tax rates than ordinary wage earners erodes trust and tax morale nationally.
source_title: Rike land stikker kjepper i hjulene i kampen mot skattetriksing
grading_note: Tax Justice leader arguing that low effective tax rates for the super-rich erode trust and tax morale

design_detail: Advocating for international tax convention to curb aggressive tax avoidance by the wealthy
quote_original: Det er en alvorlig mangel ved internasjonal rett at det ikke finnes en konvensjon som løser problemene med skattetriksing.
quote_en: It is a serious flaw in international law that there is no convention that solves the problems of tax avoidance.
source_title: Rike land stikker kjepper i hjulene i kampen mot skattetriksing
grading_note: Kirkens Nødhjelp adviser advocating for international tax justice and progressive wealth taxation

design_detail: Co-authoring analysis warning that lower tax rates on the richest destroy social trust
quote_original: At de aller rikeste har betydelig lavere skattesatser enn vanlige lønnsmottakere, sliter på tilliten og skattemoralen nasjonalt.
quote_en: That the very richest have significantly lower effective tax rates than ordinary wage earners erodes trust and tax morale nationally.
source_title: Rike land stikker kjepper i hjulene i kampen mot skattetriksing
grading_note: Kirkens Nødhjelp co-authored statement supporting tax justice and fair taxation of wealth

design_detail: Highlighting Piketty's case that annual wealth tax is essential alongside progressive income tax
quote_original: Kombinasjonen av forskjellige mekanismer hvor formuesskatten tilskrives en nøkkelrolle, er avgjørende. Dette fordi historien, ifølge Piketty, har vist at det ikke er tilstrekkelig å ha progressiv skatt på inntekt og arv.
quote_en: The combination of different mechanisms where the wealth tax is ascribed a key role is crucial. This is because history, according to Piketty, has shown that it is not sufficient to have progressive taxes on income and inheritance.
source_title: Piketty, Støre og saklig norsk skattedebatt
grading_note: Professor of political philosophy explaining why wealth tax is essential alongside income tax to curb inequality

design_detail: Affirming that wealth tax plays a vital role in redistributing wealth and combating growing inequality
quote_original: For ulikheten i Norge har økt, ulikhet er et problem, og formuesskatten spiller en viktig rolle for omfordeling.
quote_en: Because inequality in Norway has grown, inequality is a problem, and the wealth tax plays an important role in redistribution.
source_title: Huskelapp til skattekommisjonen: Ulikhet er et problem for Norge
grading_note: Head of analysis at Tankesmien Agenda emphasizing wealth tax's essential role in redistribution

design_detail: Opposing tax commission recommendations that shift tax burdens from wealth to ordinary workers
quote_original: Men likevel har altså regjeringen satt sammen en skattekommisjon som konkluderer med kutt i formuesskatt som skal lastes vanlige arbeidsfolk.
quote_en: Yet the government has appointed a tax commission that concludes with wealth tax cuts that are to be borne by ordinary working people.
grading_note: Agenda special adviser criticizing proposals to cut the wealth tax

design_detail: Exposing corporate lobbying campaigns aimed at dismantling the wealth tax
quote_original: Vi så det under forrige valgkamp, hvor noen av Norges aller rikeste brukte betydelige summer på å påvirke politikken i sin retning, med det formål å kutte formuesskatten.
quote_en: We saw it during the last election campaign, where some of Norway's very richest spent significant sums to influence politics in their direction, with the purpose of cutting the wealth tax.
grading_note: Agenda adviser analyzing how big fortunes lobby against wealth taxation

design_detail: Arguing that wealth tax is crucial to prevent the ultra-wealthy from paying zero tax
quote_original: Formuesskatt og boligskatt er avgjørende for at vi ikke skal ende i en situasjon der mange av de aller rikeste blir nullskattytere. Det har vært kjernen i Høyres problem hver gang skattedebatten har kommet opp.
quote_en: Wealth tax and property tax are crucial to prevent ending up in a situation where many of the richest become zero-taxpayers. That has been at the core of Høyre's problem whenever the tax debate has emerged.
grading_note: Agenda partner emphasizing wealth tax is crucial to prevent super-rich from paying zero tax

design_detail: Analyzing the systemic importance of third-party reporting for effective wealth taxation
quote_original: Særlig spiller tredjepartsrapportering en viktig rolle i skattesystemet, og for en effektiv formuesbeskatning.
quote_en: In particular, third-party reporting plays an important role in the tax system, and for effective wealth taxation.
grading_note: Agenda economist analyzing why third-party reporting makes the Norwegian wealth tax effective and robust

design_detail: Defending democratic tax policy and wealth taxation against coordinated billionaire campaign
quote_original: Et panikkslagent næringsliv – NHO og milliardærer i kor – har brukt alle midler i en nasjonal påvirkningskampanje for å senke skatten
quote_en: A panicked business lobby – NHO and billionaires in chorus – has used every means in a national influence campaign to lower the tax
grading_note: Commentator defending progressive wealth taxation against aggressive corporate lobbying

design_detail: Citing research and tax commissions showing wealth tax is among the most effective redistributive taxes
quote_original: Sjølv om det er solid dokumentasjon i både forsking og skattekommisjonar som viser at formuesskatten er ein av dei mest utjamnande skattane me har, og at han er svært treffsikker når det kjem til at å sikra at dei aller rikaste bidreg til fellesskapet, så fekk likevel forteljinga frå sympatiske bedrifter prega debatten i fleire år.
quote_en: Even though there is solid documentation in both research and tax commissions showing that the wealth tax is one of the most redistributive taxes we have, and that it is highly targeted when it comes to ensuring the richest contribute to society, the narrative from sympathetic businesses nevertheless dominated the debate for several years.
source_title: Trollmannen frå Os som redda valet
grading_note: Storting MP and SV finance spokesperson defending wealth tax as one of the most effective equalizing taxes

design_detail: Defending wealth taxation to ensure that the wealthiest contribute proportionally
quote_original: Kampen for eit rettferdig skattenivå, for at stemmesetelen skal telja meir enn pengesetelen, og for eit samfunn der dei som har mest, faktisk bidreg mest, er langt frå over. Me i SV kjem til å stå på, leggja fakta på bordet og avsløra mytane.
quote_en: The fight for a fair level of taxation, so that the ballot counts more than the wallet, and for a society where those who have the most actually contribute the most, is far from over. We in SV will persist, put facts on the table and dispel the myths.
source_title: Trollmannen frå Os som redda valet
grading_note: Political adviser for SV affirming commitment to progressive wealth taxation and dispelling myths

design_detail: Explaining and endorsing Piketty's comprehensive progressive wealth tax proposal
quote_original: Pikettys forslag om en global formueskatt har heller ikke fått mye oppmerksomhet i den norske debatten. Forslaget er ganske enkelt: ta all kapital, inkludert eiendom, aksjer, software, kunst og luksusgjenstander, og trekk fra all gjeld. Så legger du en progressiv skatt på det resterende
quote_en: Piketty's proposal for a global wealth tax has not received much attention in the Norwegian debate either. The proposal is quite simple: take all capital, including real estate, stocks, software, art and luxury items, subtract all debt. Then place a progressive tax on the remainder
source_title: Piketty, Robin Hood og nyttige utopier
grading_note: Political scientist and writer analyzing and supporting comprehensive progressive wealth taxation
